rics.meaning: Final Consumption Expenditure, Private — household + NPISH (non-profit institutions) consumption in constant prices.
rics.how_to_use: Tracks household + non-profit final consumption. Slightly broader than household-only consumption (aIDCPCED/CA).

rics.description: Final Consumption Expenditure, General Government, Current Prices, Consumption, Quarterly, Statistics Indonesia
rics.meaning: Final Consumption Expenditure, General Government, Current Prices — nominal government consumption.
rics.how_to_use: Use real version for cycle analysis; nominal for fiscal arithmetic.

rics.meaning: Government Spending (Constant Prices) — government final consumption expenditure in real terms. Same concept as aIDCGCED/CA.
rics.how_to_use: Cross-check series. Use either for government-spending volume tracking.
